feature_contract.goal: Restore original C993 central lens-dot WVP provenance through successful full and partial game D3D9 vertex constant uploads within the exact same physical draw, then enable the existing R84 per-eye lens centre correction without promoting any stale or foreign matrix as stereo evidence.
feature_contract.scope_boundary: Only original C993 lens-centre raw c64..c67 staging and source ownership; protect CABE outer flare discs, SkyGlow, original input/FFB, DX9Ex fallback, DX11 and frozen DXVK.
trace_stages: Native C993 central D3A5 lens source emits full or partial c64..c67 game SetVertexShaderConstantF under exact semantic producer token.
OutRun renderer accepts native game D3D9 writes and collects committed full matrix plus subsequent same-call/same-draw c64 row replacements with device, shader, pose and epoch ownership.
R84 optical path consumes only validated raw WVP evidence for original centre render; differing scene effects or invalid owners fall back to original source and preserve per-eye host composition.
subcomponents: Modify PartialWvpUpload to distinguish committed full original c64..c67 state from tentative partial row collection and preserve exact same-draw unwritten D3D9 rows.
Wire successful direct full uploads and complete split uploads in live outrun_renderer.cpp to commit source WVP, while invalid or failed/cross-draw/non-centre uploads revoke unsafe reuse.
Extend C++ regression smoke/static assertions for full-to-partial row replacement, foreign call, new physical draw, failed native write and no accidental completion of an incomplete upload.

diagnosis.original_evidence: Original D3D9 SetVertexShaderConstantF retains earlier c64 rows across later successful partial writes. Existing R84 C993 staging reset a complete matrix immediately and would not retain native untouched rows for a same-physical-draw source update.
source_trace: Original D3A5→C993 direct lens central dot producer and semantic SourceRender token.
outRun_renderer game device native SetVertexShaderConstantF c64..c67 succeeds before partial WVP collection and CommitComplete bookkeeping.
R84 stereo lens raw-WVP ownership checks same producer call, latched pose, physical draw, shader epoch and device before any per-eye optical transform.
diagnosis.root_cause: A completed but immediately discarded exact C993 source raw WVP lost unwritten native D3D9 c64 rows when a later same-draw partial upload occurred, despite real D3D9 register retention; this could deny otherwise valid central-dot stereo evidence.
alternatives_rejected: Previously present raw source provenance and R84 per-eye lens handling were not missing, so introducing a duplicate C993 hook or altering CABE outer discs would be unrelated.
Combining rows across different physical draws, foreign source tokens, invalid writes or different shader/device epochs is forbidden because it can synthesize an incorrect centre transform.
